author: ImNotYourTiger
body:
Hey, 

So I would like to appeal my most recent infraction by resepignev, given on December 2nd, 2015. At the time, I was in a small section with Nemo, joking around with him, and not causing a disruption to other players nor ruining any gameplay for them. We were in a teamspeak channel together. Also, I feel enough time has passed and I would like to appeal this please.

Thanks!

replies.author: ImNotYourTiger
replies.body:
Apologies, but you kicked me 2 times for teamgriefing, 1 which is the one I'm appealing, and one where I was placing blocks as I ran. That was also not correct. I was on a map (forgot the name, it had a giant Christmas tree in the middle) and there was a bridge to middle. I ran on it and placed blocks under me to jump on another bridge. Yet, someone who was building the bridge reported me for "teamgriefing". Anyway you can do something about this aswell? 
Sorry for taking your time, but thanks for the effort!

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heeya Tigger_The_Bear,

As I said I have little to no memory to this day, also no chat logs or video evidence.
Since there is no evidence to support the ban, I would say it's the best thing to appeal it.

Regarding the kick, normally we don't appeal kicks or warns.
But as far as I know it was on Senex III, they players were building a big pool and you decided to run through it and place blocks everywhere. After asking you to stop you proceeded.
Maybe you mixed it up with jivehs kick. Therefor it'll stay

Regards Flo/resepignev :)
